lines.trans: Dima asked to prepare the dish with tenderloin that he ate at lunch.
Which dish?
Tenderloin with balsamic pearls from the molecular cuisine.
I no longer have the required ingredient.
Stop laughing!
Replace it with something else, make it quickly.
Why didn't you tell me?
Because I betrayed my principles.
If I betrayed my principles, that means I could betray you too.
Come on, Nastya, don't talk nonsense.

examples.text: Ты когда прилетаешь? Завтра?
examples.trans: When do you fly in? Tomorrow?

examples.text: Я не позавтракал сегодня.
examples.trans: I didn't have breakfast today.

examples.text: А если мне завтра что-нибудь другое захочется?
examples.trans: And what if tomorrow I feel like having something else?

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'хотеться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will feel like'.

related.gloss: not to will feel like (negated infinitive)

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и захотеться вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and will feel like on time.

examples.text: На нашей кухне все умеют захотеться.
examples.trans: In our kitchen everyone knows how to will feel like.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'also', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Так, это мне нельзя. Это тоже.
examples.trans: Right, I am not allowed to have this. This either.

examples.text: Я тоже в общую кассу положил.
examples.trans: I also put money into the common pool.

examples.text: Я тоже не смогу сдержаться.
examples.trans: I won't be able to hold back either.

meanings.en: to be able to, to manage to
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'мочь'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will be able to', paired with 'мочь'.

examples.text: Ты так погоду смотрела?
examples.trans: Were you checking the weather like that?

examples.text: Я тоже не смогу сдержаться.
examples.trans: I won't be able to hold back either.

examples.text: На дорогу надо смотреть, когда вы ходите, а не по сторонам.
examples.trans: You need to look at the road when you walk, and not all around.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'держаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to hold back, restrain oneself'.

related.gloss: not to to hold back (negated infinitive)

examples.text: Я тоже не смогу сдержаться.
examples.trans: I won't be able to hold back either.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и сдержаться вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and to hold back on time.
